What to record: Identify site, room, elevation, cabinet, or installed component.
Example: Residence A / kitchen / wall run W

What to record: Record the released documents and when the condition was installed or checked.
Identify the installer and independent verifier or responsible trade.
State the floor, wall, centerline, finished face, or benchmark used.
List installed, missing, held, transferred, and owner-supplied items.
Record level, plumb, alignment, reveals, scribe gaps, finish, and damage.
Test doors, drawers, hardware, appliances, anchors, and access.
Record open items, owner, due date, photos, room protection, and signer.
